title: Baby Leo and Friends Learn About Healthy Eating
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends learn about healthy foods! Bella has a tasty idea to show everyone how yummy fruits and veggies can be. Together, they discover that eating healthy helps them feel happy and strong.
lesson: Kids learn the importance of healthy eating and trying new foods.
beats: Baby Leo and friends gather in a sunny garden. They talk about their favorite snacks. Bobo mentions he loves snacks but wants to eat healthy. Bella smiles and has an idea!
Bella shows everyone a colorful basket filled with fruits and veggies. She explains how each one helps them grow strong. Marjona is excited and wants to try them all!
The friends each pick a fruit or veggie. Baby Leo chooses a bright orange carrot. Bobo picks a juicy red tomato. Twinkle grabs a shiny green apple.
They sit together for a picnic. Bella leads a game where they describe the colors and shapes of their foods. Everyone laughs and has fun sharing their choices.
Suddenly, Bobo is unsure about eating his tomato. He says he doesn't like it. Baby Leo encourages him to take a small bite. 'You might like it!' he says.
Bobo takes a tiny bite and grins! 'Wow! It’s yummy!' he cheers. Everyone claps. Bella adds that trying new foods can be exciting and fun.
Marjona starts singing a little song about fruits and veggies. The friends join in and dance around their picnic. They are so happy!
After the picnic, they all agree to try new healthy snacks at home. Baby Leo reminds everyone that learning about food is like exploring, just like their adventure with animals!
